title: These Solar Panels Stay Cool in Hot Climates
author: Shannon Cuthrell
summary: Summer heat is a major problem for silicon solar panels. They typically lose 0.5 percent of their efficiency for every degree their temperature rises above 25 °C. That’s a problem in hot places like Baghdad, where air temperatures can top 50 °C and prolonged sunlight can push panel surfaces toward 80 °C. title: Book Review: When the Dust Settles - Stories of Love, Loss and Hope from an Expert in Disaster by Lucy Easthope ★★★★★
author: Terence Eden
summary: This is a difficult but essential book. I was initially put off by how graphically autobiographical it is. The disaster planning I came for was frequently interrupted with the author's loves, disasters, health issues, pains, and domestic issues. As the book wore on, I realised how vital that is. Disasters - whether natural or caused by human actions - cannot be tackled in a dispassionate way.…
